description: This file defines functions and types related to displaying and formatting session data in a table, including session row structure, default configurations, and formatting utilities for session keys, age, model, and flags.

methods.name: toSessionDisplayRows
methods.description: Converts a store of session entries into a sorted array of display rows with computed age and session info.

methods.name: resolveSessionDisplayDefaults
methods.description: Resolves default session display configuration, primarily the model, based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: resolveSessionDisplayModel
methods.description: Resolves the display model for a session row, falling back to defaults if necessary.

methods.name: truncateSessionKey
methods.description: Truncates a session key to fit within a specified padding, adding ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: formatSessionKeyCell
methods.description: Formats a session key for display, optionally applying theme styling.

methods.name: formatSessionAgeCell
methods.description: Formats the age of a session for display, showing 'unknown' if no date is available.

methods.name: formatSessionModelCell
methods.description: Formats the session model for display, defaulting to 'unknown' if null.

methods.name: formatSessionFlagsCell
methods.description: Generates a string of session flags based on row properties, optionally styled with theme.
